_comment: Course-wide snapshot years shared by every stage. fetch-base.mjs fills source_year and gap from historical-basemaps index.json using `rule` (nearest-not-after: latest base map not later than the calendar year; or nearest). A snapshot may pin a base year with source_override. The cartouche shows calendar year · base map source_year when they differ. A snapshot with "stages" belongs only to those stages and their variants ("world" also covers world-atlantic, world-americas); the rest are shared by every stage.

snapshots.override_reason: The 1400 map still shows the Mongol Great Khanate over China and has no Moscow; 1492 shows the Ming Empire and the Grand Duchy of Moscow. Trade-off: 1492 already shows Constantinople as Ottoman (fell 1453).

snapshots.stages_reason: Added 2026-11-06 for the world stage (Unit 4 voyages: 1530 for Magellan-Elcano, 1650 for the mid-century galleon and Atlantic maps). Not on the Afro-Eurasia stage until the owner decides.
